title: docs(changeset): date the spec-symbol gate's export filter in the #6286 release note (objectui#9528)
body:
Fixes #9528

Clause-②: no — release-note prose; no contract, accept set or public surface changes (a contract review is still owed: the diff is `.changeset` prose)

## What changes

One sentence in the **pending** `.changeset/6286-explain-batch-cap-from-spec.md`. That body publishes verbatim into `@object-ui/plugin-grid`'s CHANGELOG at the next release, and the release PR objectui#5400 regenerates from `main`, so this only helps if it lands before that PR merges. The frontmatter is untouched: `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` prints `declared at base: @object-ui/plugin-grid: patch` and `declares now: @object-ui/plugin-grid: patch`.

Before:

> … is exactly the drift `scripts/check-spec-symbol-derivation.mjs` argues about — and could not catch here, because both of its scanners skip non-exported declarations and this const was module-local (objectui#5899).

After:

> … is exactly the drift `scripts/check-spec-symbol-derivation.mjs` argues about — and could not catch here: when this change landed, both of its scanners skipped non-exported declarations, and this const was module-local (objectui#5899). objectui#6291 has since removed that filter from both scanners.

## Why this wording, and why the history stays

The sentence was **true when written and went false later**. It is not a false sentence from the start. So the fix keeps the explanation, puts it in the past tense and dates it. Deleting it would lose true history.

**1. True when the changeset landed.** `c38162d7c9` (#6333, 2026-08-25) added the changeset. At that commit, both scanners in the gate open with the same filter line, once in `scanFileForClaims` (rule 2) and once in `scanFile` (rule 1):

```
if (!hasExportModifier(stmt)) continue;
```

The table below counts that line and two related markers in each revision of the gate file (`git show REV:scripts/check-spec-symbol-derivation.mjs | grep -c …`):

| revision | `if (!hasExportModifier(stmt)) continue;` | `const hasExportModifier` | `// No export filter` |
|---|---|---|---|
| `c38162d7c9` (#6333 lands) | 2 | 1 | 0 |
| `9207c53e45^` | 2 | 1 | 0 |
| `9207c53e45` (#7274, objectui#6291) | 0 | 1 | 2 |
| `b120b66077` (this PR's base) | 0 | 0 | 3 (two code comments plus one header mention of them) |

**2. False since `9207c53e45`** (#7274, objectui#6291, 2026-09-02). On the base, the two scanners now carry `// No export filter: a module-local declaration carrying a spec-alignment` in `scanFileForClaims` and `// No export filter (objectui#6291). A module-local declaration under a spec` in `scanFile`. The gate's own header says the same thing: "⛔ HISTORY, NOT BEHAVIOUR. Neither scanner has an export filter today."

The order of the two commits was checked on a shallow checkout, so it needs a control leg:
- `git merge-base --is-ancestor c38162d7c9 9207c53e45` exits 0.
- The reverse check exits 1.
- Control leg: `git merge-base --is-ancestor 62311b6419 c38162d7c9` exits 0. `62311b6419` is the gate's first commit (2026-07-30), older than both.

**3. Which rule would catch this const, then and now.** I measured this with a 2×2 probe, not read it off the header:
- **Fixture A** is the pre-#6333 hook source, `git show c38162d7c9^:packages/plugin-grid/src/hooks/useRecordCrudVerdicts.ts`. In it, `const EXPLAIN_BATCH_MAX_RECORD_IDS = 200;` is module-local.
- **Fixture B** is the same file with `export` added. It is the control.
- Both fixtures were fed to the scanners of both gate versions, using today's spec export set (5085 names; `EXPLAIN_BATCH_MAX_RECORD_IDS` maps to `@objectstack/spec/security`).
- The only change to the `c38162d7c9` copy was exporting its `scanFile`. The anchor count was checked on disk: 1 plain before and 0 after; 0 exported before and 1 after.

| fixture | gate at `c38162d7c9`: rule 1 | rule 2 | gate at `b120b66077`: rule 1 | rule 2 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A — module-local (verbatim) | none | none | `const` finding | none |
| B — `export` added (control) | `const` finding | none | `const` finding | none |

What the probe shows:
- **When #6286 landed, the export filter is what hid the const from rule 1.** The control proves the old rule 1 flags the const as soon as it is exported.
- **Today rule 1 (the name match) reports it.** `DEBT` is empty and no `ALLOW` key names it, so it would be a fresh finding and the gate would exit 1.
- **Rule 2 reports it in no cell, and no filter is involved.** `findClaim` returns `null` on the const's doc comment. The comment names `@objectstack/spec@17.0.0-rc.6` but contains none of the `CLAIM_PATTERNS` phrases.
- So for this const, the card is right that rule 1 is the operative rule. The claim note's point is also true: both scanners dropped the filter. But that matters for rule 2 only in general, not for this const.

The new sentence therefore states only history: the filter existed when the change landed, and objectui#6291 removed it from both scanners. It asserts no live capability of the gate, so a later change to the gate cannot make it false the way the old sentence became false (AGENTS.md #9).

## The other pending changesets that name the gate

`git grep -l check-spec-symbol-derivation b120b66077 -- .changeset` lists **seven** files. As a positive control, the same form of search for `plugin-grid` in the 6286 file counts 1. I widened the search to every spelling of the gate (`spec-symbol`, `check:spec-symbols`), which gives **17** files, and read all 17 in full. I also grepped every pending body for `non-exported|unexported|not exported|export filter|hasExportModifier|export modifier|exported only` and for `module-local`. **Only the 6286 file states the export-filter property.** The other 16 say nothing about it:

- `7265-core-context-token-mirrors`, `7265-data-objectstack-filter-operator-rename`, `7265-components-sort-direction-bound`, `7265-plugin-detail-record-alert-renderer-props`, `spec-symbol-mirrors-app-shell-7265`, `7265-types-user-filter-field-derives`, `9596-debt-issue-anchor-truthiness`: these describe module-local mirrors that the rule-1 `DEBT` ledger carried, which fits today's behaviour.
- `console-form-container-specs-one-declaration-5596`: says derivation is the gate's sanctioned form.
- `listview-comment-pair-4559`: says rule 2 reads the *attached* comment block.
- `9542-result-dialog-i18nlabel`: names the rule-2 failure class.
- `3162-types-ledger-batch8-verdicts`, `spec-pin-17-1-0-5328`, `spec-refresh-17-2-0-5668`: ledger and pin history.
- `ci-decide-markdown-trace-9241`: says the gate opens `content/docs/**`.
- `8841-tree-view-config-derive` and `date-range-default-range-binding-4984`: explain a miss by **name matching** (and, in 4984, rule 2's tie test). That is a different property, which I did not re-measure here.

## Gates (all read at HEAD `25b8b6eeb2`, the only commit on this branch)

| command | exit | verdict line |
|---|---|---|
| `pnpm check:changeset-claims` | 0 | `✅  No pending changeset names a file this change touches.`; self-contradiction: `Every package declared across those 1 body(ies) is either not negated in its own prose, …`; born-false: `Line addresses read in them: 0.` |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | 0 | `✅  No source or published contract of a released package changed in this range, so no changeset is owed.` |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` | 0 (report-only) | `1 modified` — case 2, "CORRECTING a declaration on purpose … prose that no longer matches the change"; the declared package set is unchanged |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` | 0 | ✅ No changeset declares a major bump. |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs` | 0 | `✅  All workspace packages are in the changeset fixed group.` |
| `pnpm check:control-bytes` | 0 | `✅  check-control-bytes: OK (scanned 9240 tracked text file(s); skipped 85 binary).` |
| `pnpm check:new-line-citations` | 0 | `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s), enforcement report-only -> exit 0` |
| `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` on the 24 `scripts/__tests__/*.test.ts` that mention `.changeset` (via `os-verify-lock.sh`) | 0 | `Test Files  24 passed (24)` / `Tests  914 passed (914)` / `VERDICT command-exit 0` |

The 24-file set is a superset of what `node scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs --changed -` returns for this file. That helper records `.changeset/**` as the input of `check-changeset-no-major.test.ts`; the positive control is `packages/plugin-dashboard/README.md`, which it echoes back. No package source, gate or test is touched, so nothing else is owed. `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on the file answers `✅ NOT GOVERNED`.

## Acceptance notes

- `spec-symbol-mirrors-app-shell-7265` reads "held six declarations … Four are now bound … and three were renamed". That is 4 + 3 against six. Its commit (`14a1b92035`, #9465) removes six app-shell names from `DEBT`, so one name may have held two declarations. **I did not measure this.** That changeset has empty frontmatter, so it publishes nothing. Nobody is carrying this; it is only noted here.
- The 24-file test run printed one `fatal: Invalid symmetric difference expression 0000…` line on stderr while every test passed. The SHA in it is all zeros; `check-changeset-overwrite.test.ts` and `docs-build-trigger.test.ts` are the two files in the set that spell such a SHA. I did not trace it further. It is not a failure.

## Contract review

A contract review is owed and the PM seat commissions it. Everything above is meant to be re-runnable: every quoted code string, commit and command reproduces on this repo. This PR touches no gate, adds no checker, and leaves the frontmatter and bump level unchanged.
